title: Florida Sightfishing with Capt. Nathaniel Lemmon
specs: Targets big 4 gamefish: redfish, spotted sea trout, snook, tarpon year-round
Operates in Mosquito Lagoon, Indian River Lagoon, New Smyrna Beach, Ponce Inlet area
Capt. Nathaniel is a full-time professional angler with over 250 fishing days per year
Sight fishing opportunities for trophy size fish including bull redfish and speckled trout
Capt. Nathaniel has numerous tournament wins and media features
No fishing license needed for guests
Kids welcome; trips should be planned around their needs and behavior is parent's responsibility
Weight and capacity restrictions on flats boat; third person possible but not guaranteed
Occasionally a third person can be added for $150 extra, not guaranteed
Groups of 4 or more can be organized using multiple boats/guides; call to discuss
includes: All rods, reels, lures, live bait provided at no extra charge
Fishing license provided covering all anglers
Digital camera provided and photos sent after trip
gap: Maximum group size not explicitly stated
blurb: Capt. Nathaniel Lemmon offers custom fishing charters in Mosquito Lagoon, Indian River Lagoon, and around New Smyrna Beach and Ponce Inlet. He targets the big 4 game species: redfish, spotted sea trout, snook, and tarpon, using live bait, lures, and flies. Charters are tailored to guest goals and skill levels, with all gear and fishing license provided.
extraNote: Deposit of $100 due within one week of booking to secure date · Deposit fully refundable if cancelled two weeks prior; otherwise forfeited · Captain may cancel trip due to hazardous weather; deposit fully refunded in that case · Boat launch locations vary; includes Parrish Park Boat Ramp (Titusville), Marina Park Boat Ramp (Titusville), Scottsmoor Landing (Mims), Kennedy Point Park (Titusville) · Year-round, weather permitting
